name: Prospect of Faith
summary: Prospector Ryedol sends you to Ironforge with Hammertoe's Amulet. Historian Karnik and Hammertoe were working together to find the lost artifacts of Uldaman, and Ryedol guesses the Shadowforge found out the pair knew more than they let on.

sections.title: A Message for Ironforge
sections.body: Ryedol sorts through who might know what to do next and settles on Historian Karnik, who is in Ironforge. You are to tell Karnik what has happened to Hammertoe and place the amulet in the historian's hands. Karnik will say what needs doing from there.

sections.title: Karnik's Welcome
sections.body: Karnik greets you as just another traveler asking for time and has none to spare, until the amulet is shown. Then Karnik takes the matter seriously, puts mourning for Hammertoe aside for later, and shows you why the amulet is worth so much by calling up Hammertoe's spirit.

aliases: where to start prospect of faith
faq.answer: Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands sends you on to Ironforge with Hammertoe's Amulet.

aliases: why send the amulet to karnik
faq.answer: Karnik and Hammertoe were working together to find the lost artifacts of Uldaman, so Ryedol trusts Karnik to know what to do.

aliases: next quest after prospect of faith
faq.answer: Karnik's part of the story carries on with Passing Word of a Threat.
